description: Fork of exp080 with four changes: (1) token-embedding dim E 16 -> 32; (2) out_proj output dim O 16 -> 32; (3) concat order flipped to [out_real, x_resid] (most-recent block output is now at the FRONT of the residual stream); (4) QK/V partition_sets are per-O-chunk: at L_k>=1 the input is split into (k+2) zones of 32 each (one per block output + one for token_emb); pairs sampled within each chunk. Per-layer input dims: L0=32, L1=64, L2=96, L3=128, L4=160, L5=192; final concat=224. n_steps=8000, out_tph=1024 flat.
